title: Warehouse pick accuracy
bodyMd:
Each pick is independently checked against its order. Correct picks are counted once; an incorrect pick may contain any number of errors.

| Category | Checked picks | Correct picks |
|---|---:|---:|
| Zone Amber | 200 | 190 |
| Zone Blue | 300 | 270 |
| Zone Copper | 500 | 475 |
